svg.text: ESP32MCCAN main board housing — 1:1 on A3
Top view, lid off (antenna edge at top). Board coordinates: origin = board top-left.
Cable wall from outside (glands: low/high rows)
+x side (vent), cable wall to the right
Lid screw, M3 x 8 pan head, A2 stainless
Board screw, M3 x 6 pan head + washer, A2
Nylon M3 x 8 screw + nylon M3 nut
H2 board fixing (antenna zone, no metal)
Nylon M3 x 12 screw + nylon M3 nut
lid screws over the antenna, nut in boss pocket
Cable gland M12 x 1.5, nylon IP68 + locknut
Cable gland M16 x 1.5, nylon IP68 + locknut
Rubber grommet + steel sleeve, M5 bolt
Wall 2.5, floor 2.5, draft 1.0 deg, standoffs 8.0 (top face 6.0 dia).
Lid to L2 >= 11.0 mm; groove 2.7 x 1.5 for 2.0 cord.
13 lid screws outside the seal; nylon ones over the antenna zone.
Fit the board before the vent: the vent's inside nut overhangs the board edge.
Print: ASA, >= 5 perimeters, >= 6 top/bottom, base open-side up.
